articles.summary: Don’t defer what can be defined during design. TJI® joists should be fully specified in the construction documents at permit submittal rather than treated as deferred submittals or delegated design items. Unlike job-specific structural systems, such as metal plate connected wood trusses, TJI® joists have published, code-evaluated design properties and do not require project-specific product engineering by the manufacturer or supplier. Deferring TJI® joist design can shift key coordination decisions into bidding and construction phases, creating unnecessary or inaccurate assumptions, requests for information, approval delays and added construction costs.
articles.title: Why TJI® Joist Specification Belongs in the Permit Documents
